cohort: Very preterm infants (VPIs) born at a gestational age of 24(+0)-31(+6) weeks and admitted to 57 tertiary NICUs of the Chinese Neonatal Network (CHNN) in 2019
finding: While VPIs born to mothers with HDP had higher rates of mortality or any morbidity, this association was not significant after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: Mothers with hypertensive disorder of pregnancy were more likely to receive cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Not specified, but infants of mothers with HDP had lower birth weight
